name: gold-pack
_comment: restyle-back.cjs: the 151 back restyled to a graded front. Only the colours are per pack; the film level, sheen, grain and chroma are measured from the front by the tool.

palette._source: gold-pack-front.webp. metal = median of the brightest 30% of the tier lettering box (170-760 x 1320-1419); pale = median of the brightest 25% of the logo box (285-640 x 545-1000); dark = median of the darkest 10% of the body

_printHold: Accepted plate: its live zones already meet the print-area contrast target as printed, so the print-area hold stays off and the plate reproduces byte for byte.
